''See also: [[Champion’s Guild Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Champion]]’s [[Guild]] is one of the ten influential [[Imperial Guilds]] and holds the distinction of being the second oldest, trailing only the [[Consultants]]. Historically, the guild has had a massive impact on the unification of [[The Empire|the Empire]], with legendary figures noting that securing a [[Champion]]'s support often guarantees victory. The organization is represented by the [[Golden Crown]] symbol and has traditionally provided security for [[The Empire|the Empire]]. A [[Champion]] is a specialized warrior who differs from a standard [[Soulbound]] through a secret, alchemical process that enhances their physical and mental capabilities. These individuals are trained from childhood through an intense, often violent regimen of combat and physical testing to ensure only the strongest survive. This process results in superhuman fighters capable of extreme feats of strength, though it is noted that such enhancements can lead to heart failure. Because the specific alchemical formulas used to create [[Champions]] are proprietary secrets, their [[blood]] is considered a highly valuable resource. In recent times, the guild has faced significant instability. Following the death of the Emperor, the organization has struggled with a lack of direction, internal division, and a shortage of [[Alchemists|alchemists]]. The former [[Blackwatch Guild Head|Guild Head]], [[Baldesar Kern]], announced the complete dissolution of the guild, leaving only individual [[Champions]] behind. While some members remain neutral or work as mercenaries, others have attempted to rebuild the guild's structure under different leadership.}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Champion]]’s [[Guild]] is an organization that employs [[Alchemists|alchemists]] and provides [[blood]] samples to support alchemical research. During her time spent within the guild, [[Petal]] secured a position dedicated to this research. However, the group has largely dispersed and no longer offers its full support to [[Calder]]. Consequently, the guild stands as one of the entities most heavily impacted by the recent departure of its [[Alchemists|alchemists]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Champion’s Guild]] provides [[blood]] samples for alchemical research.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c3">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 3</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Petal]] found a research position in the [[Champion’s Guild]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c4">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Champion’s Guild]] is not fully behind [[Calder]] and has largely dispersed.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Champion’s Guild]] is one of the groups most affected by the departure of the [[Alchemists|alchemists]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c6">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Petal]] spent time in the [[Champion’s Guild|Champion's Guild]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 17</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Champion’s Guild|Champion's Guild]] has [[Alchemists|alchemists]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17" />}}</li>
</ul></div>
